idea-plugin.name: Hagalaz
idea-plugin.description:
Hagalaz — a dark fantasy / evil-castle UI theme for JetBrains IDEs.

Ash-black, bone, iron, and blood red. Torches flicker, embers drift, crows circle a black eclipse over a castle-cathedral. Ported from the Hagalaz Omarchy / Hyprland desktop theme.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 — Initial release. Full UI theme + bundled editor color scheme.
